infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: WorkTrack uses your location only while the app is open to verify you are at your registered office when you punch in, take a break, or punch out. Your location is not tracked in the background.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: WorkTrack uses your location only while the app is open to verify you are at your registered office when recording attendance. Location is never collected in the background.
